name: opencode-gui
description: Build a modern GUI for interacting with opencode, as a CLIENT on opencode's own server + SDK — not a new agent runtime. Ground truth measured 2026-10-03: opencode 1.18.34, @opencode-ai/sdk 1.18.18, ~170 HTTP endpoints across 36 client groups, SSE event streams, and existing surfaces opencode serve / web / attach / acp. 20 steps in 5 lanes of 4, kanban columns Backlog->Ready->In Progress->Review->Done with WIP limit 1 and dependency gating. Every exit criterion is a command that exits 0; a criterion that cannot be automated is a documented manual gate in step 19, not a fake automated one. Full detail incl. per-step deliverables and requirement quotes traced to Jayson's own session history: /opt/mem20/roadmaps/opencode-gui.md

phases.name: Step 0: Ground the substrate - generate checked SDK/endpoint facts
Step 1: Freeze the API contract - pinned versioned generated contract
Step 2: Decide transport and SDK surface - v1 vs v2, SSE vs poll, by measurement
Step 3: Security and network posture - bind, auth, CORS, fail closed
Step 4: Repo and design system - tokens, components, nav shell
Step 5: Process broker - single owner of the opencode process, systemd
Step 6: Typed client layer - generated, zero hand-written fetch
Step 7: Event stream - SSE with reconnect, backoff, resync
Step 8: Sessions and project scope - list, create, fork, tree
Step 9: Streaming message and part renderer - all part types, no viewport jump
Step 10: Permissions and questions - first-class blocking prompts
Step 11: Interrupt, revert, undo, context meter
Step 12: Files, search, symbols - tree, viewer, find
Step 13: Diff and VCS review - inspect, apply, verify against git
Step 14: Embedded terminal - PTY with connect-token
Step 15: Models, providers, auth - OAuth end to end, auto-populating picker
Step 16: MCP, skills, agents, commands, LSP
Step 17: Multi-workspace, worktrees, background sessions
Step 18: Desktop packaging, systemd, accessibility, performance
Step 19: Test suite, dogfood QA, release gate with written known-gaps
